page.title: JVTO Police Integration & Safety Authority
page.summary: The founder's active Tourist Police commission — assignment orders, rank, and independent press confirmation — and what police-standard discipline means for your tour.

lede: JVTO's safety model is built around its founder's active Tourist Police (POLPAR) commission. This page publishes the government-issued assignment orders and the independent press coverage that confirms the role.

sections.title: Official Police Assignment Documents
sections.body_md:
Two documents, both issued by the Indonesian National Police (POLRI) and both carrying SHA-256 hashes for forensic verification:

- **SPRIN-POLPAR — Tourist Police Assignment Letter.** Surat Perintah Sprin/4954/XI/2020, Polres Bondowoso. Issuer: Indonesian National Police (POLRI). SHA-256 `03c8578dc22956faa366d957badecfe38868d4760359cd8059fb2d6b145dfeab`.
- **SPRIN-WAL-TRAVEL — traffic-escort order.** Sprin/70/II/HUK.6.6./2024, 12 February 2024, Satlantas Polres Bondowoso: one escort, one route (Tol Gending Probolinggo to Bondowoso), naming PT Java Volcano Rendezvous. Issuer: Indonesian National Police (POLRI). SHA-256 `179b061eae558943fdccc51d2ea3c8233a704b61f03ca3d212433f3e8d6f3bd3`.

Scanned copies are in the evidence locker above.

sections.title: Founder — Active Tourist Police Officer
sections.body_md:
**Bripka Agung Sambuko (Mr. Sam)**

- **Rank:** Bripka (Brigadir Polisi Kepala), NRP 82071412
- **Day post:** Bintara Sie Propam, Polres Bondowoso
- **Tourist Police appointment:** Polisi Pariwisata (POLPAR) Bondowoso — Surat Perintah Sprin/4954/XI/2020, issued 13 November 2020 by the Chief of Polres Bondowoso, AKBP Erick Frendriz, S.I.K., M.Si.
- **Basis:** Perkap Polri 12/2015 on tourism security, following a request from the Bondowoso Tourism, Youth and Sports Office to form a Tourist Police unit
- **Validity:** the order states it applies *sejak tanggal dikeluarkan* (from the date of issue) and names no end date
- **Role:** Tourist Police duties alongside his daily post, within tourism governance for Bondowoso Regency — the regency that holds the Kawah Ijen access route

Two government-issued orders are published here, and they prove different things. SPRIN POLPAR (Sprin/4954/XI/2020, 13 November 2020) is the standing order appointing Agung Sambuko a Tourist Police officer for Bondowoso; it names no end date. SPRIN WAL-TRAVEL (Sprin/70/II/HUK.6.6./2024, 12 February 2024) is narrower and is not a commission at all — it is a single-day traffic-escort order issued by Satlantas Polres Bondowoso for one route, Tol Gending Probolinggo to Bondowoso, naming PT Java Volcano Rendezvous explicitly. Both are issued by the Indonesian National Police (POLRI) and carry SHA-256 hashes for forensic verification.

JVTO (PT Java Volcano Rendezvous) is a private tour operator. References to the founder's role as an active Tourist Police officer describe his personal professional background only; they do not represent or imply endorsement by the Indonesian National Police or any government body.

sections.title: What This Means for Your Tour
sections.body_md:
- **Police-standard discipline.** Tourist Police officers are trained in risk assessment, crisis response, and operational safety protocols — disciplines that transfer directly to managing tours in high-risk volcanic environments.
- **Authority, not just experience.** The Tourist Police commission is a government-issued operational authority. This is not a certification purchased from a private body — it is an assignment letter from the state.
- **Police escort available.** For large groups, a traffic police escort can be arranged via official channels. This is available on request — approval is not guaranteed and it is not automatically included in all tours.

sections.title: Independent Press Confirmation
sections.body_md:

National-reach article identifying the founder by rank (Bripka Agung Sambuko) in his Tourist Police operational context at Ijen crater. Written and published independently of JVTO. Regional press coverage of the Tourist Police (Polpar) unit formation, explicitly framing its role within the Ijen UNESCO Geopark initiative — context for the police role JVTO's founder holds. pageContent.articleIntro: "Tourist Police-Led" is a strong claim. Here is exactly what is behind it — and how to check each layer without taking our word for any of it.

— an active serving officer of the Indonesian National Police (Polri), assigned to
(Polisi Pariwisata Bondowoso — Tourist Police, Polres Bondowoso). The assignment order places him in tourism governance for Bondowoso Regency, which covers the Kawah Ijen access route.

pageContent.whatPoliceLedMeansPara2: This is not a retired officer's background or an advisory title. It is active duty, documented annually in police travel orders. In practice it means:
whatPoliceLedMeansList: Every JVTO tour operates under someone with active institutional responsibility for tourist safety in this area — a legal duty, not a marketing position.
Traffic Police escort for airport and ferry transfers is requested through formal police channels, not sold as a private security service.
Police support-vehicle presence at group departures is photographed and recurring.
pageContent.layer1Intro: Two active-duty documents are on file, each published with a SHA-256 fingerprint so a copy you receive can be verified as unaltered.

docsTable.detail: Surat Perintah — the formal assignment of Bripka Agung Sambuko to Tourist Police duties.
Police travel order authorizing him to accompany tourist groups on field operations. A 2024 date — an active-year order, not a historical artifact.

pageContent.layer2Text: Escort photographs document the police connection as a recurring operational pattern, not a one-off staged photo. Two arrival photos at the Bondowoso hotel — one in daylight, one at night, both showing the same type of patrol car and uniformed Traffic Police officer — establish repetition across separate trips. A further photo shows Mr. Sam conducting a Tourist Police briefing at the Ijen Geopark Information Center with local sulfur miners present: coordination with the Ijen community, not just guest-escort work.
pageContent.layer3Intro: Three unrelated journalists across two publications named Bripka Agung Sambuko in Tourist Police contexts — with no JVTO involvement. No tour operator can arrange independent press across three separate stories.

pressTable.detail: Direct quotes from Bripka Agung Sambuko during an overnight COVID-19 deployment at Kawah Wurung. National media, full access.
The Tourist Police unit (Polpar) documented as an institutional response to the Ijen Geopark — confirming the role is structural, not personal.
Active patrol at the Ijen crater monitoring sulfuric odor conditions — event-driven safety work, not a ceremonial title.

pageContent.trafficEscortText: JVTO submits a formal request to the Traffic Police (Lalu Lintas) — it does not provide its own escort or operate a private security service. That is why the escort photos show a real officer and a real patrol car, not branded security guards.

items.question: Is the founder really an active Tourist Police officer?
items.answer: Yes. Bripka Agung Sambuko is an active POLPAR (Polisi Pariwisata) officer under Indonesia's Polisi Pariwisata (POLPAR), Polres Bondowoso, POLRI. His identity was independently confirmed by Detik.com (March 2021 article naming him as Bripka Agung Sambuko). His current assignment is documented via SPRIN-POLPAR (Tourist Police Assignment Letter) and SPRIN-WAL-TRAVEL (single-route traffic-escort order Sprin/70/II/HUK.6.6./2024, dated 12 February 2024). JVTO is a private operator; this describes the founder's professional background and does not imply government endorsement.

items.question: What is POLPAR and why does it matter for tour operators?
items.answer: POLPAR (Polisi Pariwisata) is the Indonesian Tourist Police, formed at Polres (district police) level under Perkap Polri 12/2015. Officers are formally assigned to secure and support tourism areas via a SPRIN (Surat Perintah / official order letter) from POLRI. Having an active POLPAR officer as founder means JVTO's safety protocols are not just guidelines — they are police-standard procedures applied to volcano tourism.

items.question: Can JVTO arrange a police escort for groups?
items.answer: JVTO can arrange a traffic police escort on request for larger groups, channelled through official channels. Approval is not guaranteed and it is not automatically included in all tours. See /travel-guide/police-escort-for-groups for the request flow and applicable group-size thresholds.
